title: Jana Extra-Small Leather Convertible Crossbody Bag
description_html:
Jana Extra-Small Leather Convertible Crossbody Bag by Michael Kors. Designed with superior craftsmanship and luxury finishing.

Product Specifications

  • Dimensions: 7.5”W X 4.75”H X 2.75”D
  • Handle Drop: Handle drop: 2.75"
  • Material: The leather in this product comes from tanneries receiving Leather Working Group Gold- or Silver-certification in recognition of their environmental performance., Leather
  • Hardware: Antique gold-tone hardware
  • Lining: 100% polyester
  • Closure: Zip fastening
